title: Top secret files from the late 1800s

tellings.quote: Late 1800s, early 1900s. There are still top secret files on this issue from the late 1800s and early 1900s. We know this.

plain: Top secret US government files on UFOs are said to exist from as far back as the late 1800s and early 1900s, the time of the spiritualism wave when seances were common. Steven Greer, a campaigner for UFO disclosure, says this on the show and attributes it to a senior CIA source he does not name, telling Michels 'there are still top secret files on this issue' from that period. If true, it would mean government secrecy about the subject began decades before the modern UFO era.
